svg.title: Runtime architecture
svg.desc: Authenticated CV chat with quotas, retained history, retrieval augmented generation and Bedrock Guardrails.

g.text: Authenticated CV chat with quotas, retained history, retrieval augmented generation and Bedrock Guardrails.
Five-minute inactivity cutoff or explicit session close.
History is retained independently of expiring quota state.
Solid arrows: request / data flow · Dashed arrows: policy, identity, logging or build-time preparation · Replies return over the request path.
Source: aws/amplify.yaml + amplify.yml | Official AWS Architecture Icons: July 2026 | Logical service architecture; no VPC
